about: Research-gap benchmark, written 2026-11-15 before any run and hash-locked in eval/GAPS.lock. Reference labels were assigned by hand from the curated finding fields (materials, gravity, O2, pressure, flow, category) and the PSI-69 FLEX table, not by calling the gap functions. Written by the build assistant (internal, not independent). 'scope' records whether the gap is only in this library or also in the literature; 'literature_note' cites a source passage when the library gap is known to be covered (or explicitly flagged as open) in a NASA publication.

classes.EVIDENCE: Direct experimental finding exists for this material and condition (not a gap)
classes.CONFLICT: Direct finding exists but includes conflicting evidence (not a gap; flag the conflict)
classes.DATA_MODEL: No curated finding states this condition, but PSI-69 tests exist and a registered FLEX model covers it (not a measurement gap)
classes.GAP_MATERIAL: No direct finding for the material at all
classes.GAP_INDIRECT: Only historical-incident or related-material context; no direct experimental finding
classes.GAP_CONDITION: Material has direct findings, but none under this condition
classes.GAP_INTERACTION: No documented interaction for the pair (none, or only co-reported)
classes.OUT_OF_MODEL_DOMAIN: Prediction request outside every registered model; must be Unavailable

cases.literature_note: LUCI flew a 4 mm acrylic (PMMA) rod at simulated lunar gravity (ASGSR 2025 LUCI p.4); its result is not curated here.
SoFIE notes few thin-sheet materials are rated even in 1-g at 34% O2, 8.2 psia (20200000361 p.6).
Exploration atmosphere 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) flagged as largely unrated (20200000361 p.6).
BASS-II appendix reports slow-flow PMMA burns (TM-20210011385 p.135); quiescent PMMA not curated.

cases.basis: Declared related to PMMA, which has findings; the custom material itself has none
Adding a user material whose alias equals a catalogue name must not remove the catalogue material's findings
PSI-69: 16 methanol 1 atm N2 tests at 18-23% O2; FLEX-K-METH-1atm Model-supported
